title: Эссе "Моя Жизнь во Временах" (Супер-Финал)
description: Напиши мини-выступление о своей жизни, используя МИНИМУМ 6 разных времён.

conditions.label: Present Perfect Continuous (I have been studying English for 5 years)
Past Simple (Yesterday I passed my test)
Past Continuous (While I was writing it, my phone rang)
conditions.hint: While I (3) ___ (write) it, my phone rang.

conditions.label: Future Simple (Next year I will travel to London)
Future Perfect (By the summer I will have finished this course)
conditions.hint: By the summer, I (5) ___ (finish) this course.

conditions.label: Future (I think I will speak English fluently in the future)
conditions.hint: I think I (6) ___ (speak) English fluently in the future.

sentences: I have been studying English since Year 2, and I enjoy learning new words and practising speaking.
Yesterday, I passed my English test and felt very happy.
While I was writing the test, my phone rang, but I did not answer it.
Next year, I will travel to London and practise English with local people.
By the summer, I will have finished this English course.
I think I will speak English fluently in the future because I study regularly and do my best.
